info.title: MCP API Reference
info.description: JSON-RPC MCP endpoint client. Construct clients with the MCP endpoint URL advertised by the service. Requests must include MCP transport headers such as `Mcp-Protocol-Version` and `Mcp-Method`; method-specific requests may also require `Mcp-Name` and `Mcp-Param-*` headers.

post.description: Sends a raw MCP JSON-RPC request to the client base URL. The caller supplies required MCP transport headers.

Annotations.description: Annotations provide optional metadata for MCP resources and content.

audience.description: Audience describes who the data is intended for.

lastModified.description: LastModified is an ISO 8601 timestamp for the last modification time.

priority.description: Priority describes importance from 0 to 1, with 1 most important.

CacheScope.description: CacheScope describes who may cache an MCP result.

completions.description: Completions is present if the server supports argument completion suggestions.

experimental.description: Experimental contains non-standard capabilities supported by the server.

extensions.description: Extensions contains optional MCP extensions supported by the server.

logging.description:
DeprecatedLogging is present if the server supports sending log messages to the client.

Deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28, but still present in that
schema. This is native 2026-07-28 compatibility, not released-version
compat.go support; remove it only after the upstream 2026+ schema drops it.

prompts.description: Prompts is present if the server offers prompt templates.

resources.description: Resources is present if the server offers resources to read.

tools.description: Tools is present if the server offers tools to call.

ClientCapabilities.description: ClientCapabilities describes capabilities the client supports for a request.

elicitation.description: Elicitation is present if the client supports server-initiated user elicitation.

experimental.description: Experimental contains non-standard capabilities supported by the client.

extensions.description: Extensions contains optional MCP extensions supported by the client.

roots.description:
DeprecatedRoots is present if the client supports listing roots.

Deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28, but still present in that
schema. This is native 2026-07-28 compatibility, not released-version
compat.go support; remove it only after the upstream 2026+ schema drops it.

sampling.description:
DeprecatedSampling is present if the client supports server-initiated LLM sampling.

Deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28, but still present in that
schema. This is native 2026-07-28 compatibility, not released-version
compat.go support; remove it only after the upstream 2026+ schema drops it.

ContentBlock.description:
ContentBlock is an MCP content item.

The draft schema models this as a union. Validate checks that only fields for
the selected content type are present.

data.description: Data is base64-encoded data for image and audio blocks.

description.description: Description helps clients and LLMs understand linked resources.

mimeType.description: MimeType is required for image and audio content and optional for resources.

name.description: Name is used by resource_link content.

resource.description: Resource contains embedded resource contents for resource blocks.

size.description: Size is the raw resource size in bytes, if known.

text.description: Text is the text content for text blocks.

title.description: Title is a human-readable display name.

ContentType.description: ContentType identifies the kind of content block in a tool result.

form.description: Form declares support for form-mode elicitation.

url.description: URL declares support for URL-mode elicitation.

Extensions.description:
Extensions stores namespaced MCP extension payloads.

The draft schema constrains values to JSON objects. RawMessage keeps the DTO
forward-compatible; validate extension values before depending on object shape.

Icon.description: Icon describes an optionally-sized icon for UI display.

mimeType.description: MimeType overrides a missing or generic source MIME type.

sizes.description: Sizes lists supported dimensions, such as "48x48" or "any".

src.description: Src is an icon URI, such as an HTTPS URL or data URI.

theme.description: Theme indicates whether the icon targets a light or dark background.

Implementation.description: Implementation describes an MCP client or server implementation.

description.description: Description explains what this implementation does.

icons.description: Icons contains optional sized icons for UI display.

name.description: Name is the programmatic implementation identifier.

title.description: Title is a human-readable display name.

websiteUrl.description: WebsiteURL is an optional website for this implementation.

JSONRPCError.description: JSONRPCError is a JSON-RPC error object.

data.description: Data carries sender-defined additional error information.

message.description: Message is a concise single-sentence description of the error.

JSONRPCNotification.description: JSONRPCNotification is a JSON-RPC notification that does not expect a response.

JSONRPCRequest.description: JSONRPCRequest is a JSON-RPC request that expects a response.

JSONRPCResponse.description: JSONRPCResponse is a JSON-RPC response containing either a result or an error.

MetaObject.description:
MetaObject is metadata attached to MCP interactions.

MCP reserves protocol-level key names. Implementations should use prefixed
reverse-DNS keys for their own metadata.

Method.description: Method is an MCP JSON-RPC method name.

NotificationMethod.description: NotificationMethod is an MCP JSON-RPC notification method name.

OpenAIUserLocation.description:
OpenAIUserLocation contains optional client location hints. Only the device's
IANA timezone is used; these untrusted hints must not influence authorization.

timezone.description: Timezone is the caller device's IANA timezone, such as America/Toronto.

PaginatedRequestParams.description: PaginatedRequestParams contains common request metadata and an optional cursor.

cursor.description: Cursor is an opaque pagination token.

PromptsCapability.description: PromptsCapability describes prompt support advertised by the server.

listChanged.description: ListChanged indicates support for prompt list change notifications.

ResourceContent.description: ResourceContent contains resource data returned by resources/read.

blob.description: Blob contains base64-encoded binary resource contents.

mimeType.description: MimeType is the resource MIME type, if known.

ResourceDescriptor.description: ResourceDescriptor describes a resource the server can read.

description.description: Description helps clients and LLMs understand the resource.

mimeType.description: MimeType is the resource MIME type, if known.

name.description: Name is the programmatic resource identifier.

size.description: Size is the raw resource size in bytes, if known.

title.description: Title is a human-readable display name.

ResourceTemplateDescriptor.description: ResourceTemplateDescriptor describes a parameterized MCP resource.

description.description: Description helps clients and LLMs understand the template.

mimeType.description: MimeType is the MIME type for matching resources, if uniform.

name.description: Name is the programmatic template identifier.

title.description: Title is a human-readable display name.

uriTemplate.description: URITemplate is an RFC 6570 URI template for constructing resource URIs.

ResourceTemplatesListResult.description: ResourceTemplatesListResult is the response payload for resources/templates/list.

ResourcesCapability.description: ResourcesCapability describes resource support advertised by the server.

listChanged.description: ListChanged indicates support for resource list change notifications.

subscribe.description: Subscribe indicates support for subscribing to individual resource updates.

ResourcesListResult.description: ResourcesListResult is the response payload for resources/list.

ResourcesReadParams.description: ResourcesReadParams is the request params payload for resources/read.

inputResponses.description: InputResponses carries responses to server-initiated requests from a prior input_required result.

requestState.description: RequestState carries opaque state from a prior input_required result.

uri.description: URI identifies the resource to read.

ResourcesReadResult.description: ResourcesReadResult is the response payload for resources/read.

cacheScope.description: CacheScope indicates whether the response may be cached publicly or privately.

contents.description: Contents contains text or blob resource contents.

ttlMs.description: TTLMS hints how long clients may cache this response in milliseconds.

ResultType.description: ResultType describes whether an MCP result is complete or partial.

Role.description: Role identifies an MCP audience role.

SamplingCapability.description: SamplingCapability describes deprecated client sampling support.

ServerDiscoverResult.description: ServerDiscoverResult is the result returned for a server/discover request.

cacheScope.description: CacheScope indicates whether the response may be cached publicly or privately.

instructions.description:
Instructions gives natural-language guidance for using the server effectively.

Clients may include it in an LLM system prompt. It should not duplicate tool
descriptions.

serverInfo.description: ServerInfo describes the server software implementation.

supportedVersions.description: SupportedVersions lists MCP protocol versions supported by this server.

ttlMs.description: TTLMS hints how long clients may cache this response in milliseconds.

SubscriptionFilter.description: SubscriptionFilter describes MCP subscription notifications requested by a client.

resourceSubscriptions.description: ResourceSubscriptions requests updates for individual resource URIs.

resourcesListChanged.description: ResourcesListChanged requests resource list change notifications.

SubscriptionNotificationParams.description: SubscriptionNotificationParams is the payload for subscription notifications.

notifications.description: Notifications is the subset of requested notification types the server accepted.

SubscriptionsInitialStateParams.description:
SubscriptionsInitialStateParams is the payload for the
notifications/subscriptions/initial_state notification.

contents.description:
Contents is the resources/read result for the same target, so a client
that applies the payload holds the post-subscription state without a
second read.

uri.description: URI is the subscribed target whose initial state was delivered.

SubscriptionsListenParams.description: SubscriptionsListenParams is the request params payload for subscriptions/listen.

notifications.description: Notifications declares notification types the client opts in to.

ToolAnnotations.description: ToolAnnotations describe MCP tool behavior hints.

destructiveHint.description: DestructiveHint indicates the tool may perform destructive updates.

idempotentHint.description: IdempotentHint indicates repeated calls with the same arguments have no additional effect.

openWorldHint.description: OpenWorldHint indicates the tool may interact with external entities.

readOnlyHint.description: ReadOnlyHint indicates the tool does not modify its environment.

title.description: Title is a human-readable title for the tool.

ToolCallResult.description: ToolCallResult is the response payload for a tool call.

content.description: Content is the unstructured result of the tool call.

isError.description: IsError indicates the tool call ended in an error visible to the model.

structuredContent.description: StructuredContent is optional JSON matching the tool output schema on success.

ToolDescriptor.description: ToolDescriptor describes a tool the client can call.

annotations.description: Annotations contains optional tool behavior hints.

description.description: Description helps clients and LLMs understand the tool.

inputSchema.description: InputSchema defines the expected JSON object arguments for the tool.

name.description: Name is the programmatic tool identifier.

outputSchema.description: OutputSchema defines the structuredContent shape for successful results.

title.description: Title is a human-readable display name.

ToolsCallParams.description: ToolsCallParams is the request params payload for tools/call.

arguments.description: Arguments contains tool arguments as a JSON object.

inputResponses.description: InputResponses carries responses to server-initiated requests from a prior input_required result.

name.description: Name identifies the tool to invoke.

requestState.description: RequestState carries opaque state from a prior input_required result.

ToolsCapability.description: ToolsCapability describes tool support advertised by the server.

listChanged.description: ListChanged indicates support for tool list change notifications.

ToolsListResult.description: ToolsListResult is the response payload for tools/list.

error.description: MCP errors are JSON-RPC error objects in `JSONRPCResponse.error`. Transport-layer validation failures may use non-2xx HTTP statuses; method-level JSON-RPC errors can still use HTTP 200. Tool execution errors preserve their human-readable content and expose an application semantic code in `result._meta["com.fghbuild.gomode/errorCode"]` when one is available.
